decisions.rationale: Mega Gengar is our intended Mega. Leading Gengar + Aerodactyl gives us speed control and fast disruptions: Aerodactyl provides fast Tailwind, Taunt against Grimmsnarl/Politoed setup, and Wide Guard support, while Mega Gengar traps high-value targets with Shadow Tag, threatens burns with Will-O-Wisp, and outputs high damage. In the back, Choice Scarf Krookodile threatens big Ground damage on Archaludon, and Clefable brings Follow Me redirection to keep Gengar and Krookodile safe.
decisions.notebook: Matchup strategy: Mega Gengar traps key targets with Shadow Tag. Scarf Krookodile threatens Archaludon with High Horsepower. Aerodactyl provides Tailwind/Taunt/Wide Guard support. Clefable provides Follow Me redirection.

decisions.rationale: Lead Politoed+Archaludon. T1: Politoed Helping Hand (pri+5) on Archaludon, Archaludon Electro Shot Gengar — HH-boosted STAB likely OHKOs, removing Shadow Tag before it traps. Rain powers Weather Ball (possible OHKO on Krookodile) and halves Arcanine Fire. Back: Noivern Tailwind for mid-game speed; Mega Scizor Bullet Punch cleans weakened fast targets, Close Combat handles Krookodile. Intended Mega: Scizor.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Gengar(Gengarite→Mega Shadow Tag, Timid, 165-200 Spe), Aerodactyl(FocusSash, Unnerve, Jolly, 165-200 Spe, Tailwind/WideGuard/RockSlide/Taunt), Clefable(Sitrus, Unaware, Bold, 80-112 Spe, FollowMe/Moonblast/HH/Protect), Krookodile(ChoiceScarf, Intimidate, Adamant, 112-144→168-216 Spe, HighHorsepower/KnockOff/CC/RockSlide), Arcanine(Leftovers, Intimidate, Careful, 115-147 Spe, FlareBlitz/WoW/Snarl/ExtremeSpeed), Empoleon(LifeOrb, Competitive, Modest, 80-112 Spe, FlashCannon/Surf/IceBeam/Protect). Key: Shadow Tag prevents switching while Gengar-Mega active — must KO it or lead with intended attackers. Electro Shot immune vs Krookodile Ground. Politoed Weather Ball in rain is possible OHKO on Krookodile (71-160%). Aerodactyl outspeeds Noivern 200 vs 192 — Taunt risk on Tailwind. Rock Slide is 0.25x vs Archaludon (Steel+Dragon both resist Rock). Plan: lead Politoed+Archaludon, HH+Electro Shot to remove Gengar T1, bring Noivern for Tailwind mid-game, Mega Scizor for priority cleanup. Watch for Clefable FollowMe blocking Gengar targeting — use Flash Cannon on Clefable (SE vs Fairy) if redirected.

decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl outspeeds both foes to set Tailwind. Gengar Protect + Mega Evolve safely activates Shadow Tag while avoiding Rain-boosted attacks or LO Electro Shot. Trapping Archaludon and Politoed sets up Scarf Krookodile to clean up Archaludon with High Horsepower.
decisions.notebook: Opponent brought Rain (Politoed + Archaludon). Archaludon has Life Orb Electro Shot. Mega Gengar's Shadow Tag traps Archaludon for Scarf Krookodile.

decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl lacks Protect (only Tailwind/WideGuard/RockSlide/Taunt), so Ice Beam is guaranteed to break its Focus Sash. Protect keeps Archaludon safe from Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball (41-70%). T2: HH+ES→Gengar OHKOs (87-170%); if Taunted, Weather Ball+ES still KOs (104-200% combined). T3: Ice Beam KOs Aero at 1 HP. Robust against all opponent lines.
decisions.notebook: Aerodactyl has NO Protect — moves are Tailwind/WideGuard/RockSlide/Taunt only; single-target moves always connect. Electro Shot in rain = one-turn 130 BP + raises SpA 1 stage. ES alone vs Gengar: 58-113% (not guaranteed OHKO); HH+ES: 87-170% (guaranteed); Weather Ball(rain,Water,STAB+weather boost) vs Gengar: 45-87%, so WB+ES combined = 104-200% (always KO even without HH). Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball vs Archaludon: 41-70% — two hits KO Archaludon, so Protect T1 is critical. Rock Slide vs Politoed: 14-26% spread (minor). Opponent likely Protects Gengar T1 to safely Mega Evolve for Shadow Tag. Plan: T1 break Aero sash + Protect Archaludon; T2 HH+ES (or WB+ES if Taunted) KO Gengar; T3 Ice Beam KO Aero at 1 HP. After Gengar falls, Shadow Tag lifts and we can pivot to Noivern/Scizor.

decisions.rationale: Under Tailwind, both Mega Gengar and Aerodactyl move before Politoed and Archaludon. Shadow Ball hits Archaludon for 41-80% while trapped by Shadow Tag, and Aerodactyl's Rock Slide adds spread chip plus a 30% flinch chance on both foes before taking any attacks. Life Orb recoil on Archaludon further brings it into KO range.

WB+ES into Gengar: both 100% accuracy, Taunt-immune, combined 71.8-160.7% likely KOs offensive Timid Gengar. ES SpA+1 boost is critical insurance if Gengar survives — next turn boosted ES finishes it. DM's 10% miss + SpA-2 is too risky if Gengar lives. Priority is removing Shadow Tag this turn.
decisions.notebook: Aerodactyl has NO Protect — moves are Tailwind/WideGuard/RockSlide/Taunt only. Electro Shot in rain = one-turn 130 BP + SpA+1. ES alone vs Gengar-Mega: 35.3-80.7% (CANNOT OHKO). WB(rain) vs Gengar-Mega: 36.5-80% (CANNOT OHKO). WB+ES combined: 71.8-160.7% (likely KO offensive Gengar, not guaranteed vs heavy def investment). DM vs Gengar: 53.3-120.7% (can OHKO but 90% acc + SpA-2). Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball vs Archaludon: 41-70% — two hits KO. Rock Slide vs Politoed: 14-26% spread (minor). Opponent Protected Gengar T1 to safely Mega Evolve for Shadow Tag. After Gengar falls, Shadow Tag lifts and we can pivot to Noivern/Scizor. Aero at 45% is easy cleanup with Ice Beam next turn. Clefable has FollowMe — watch for redirection after Gengar falls.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon is at 31% HP and threatens high rain-boosted damage or Draco Meteor. Shadow Ball from Mega Gengar is a guaranteed KO before Archaludon can move under Tailwind. Aerodactyl uses Rock Slide for chip damage and flinch pressure on Politoed.
decisions.notebook: Opponent brought Rain (Politoed + Archaludon). Archaludon has Life Orb Electro Shot/Draco Meteor/Flash Cannon. Scizor/Grimmsnarl/Staraptor/Noivern in back.

decisions.rationale: Clefable is the ideal replacement here because Politoed threatens Krookodile with Rain-boosted Weather Ball. Clefable comes in at full HP with Sitrus Berry and provides Follow Me redirection next turn under Tailwind to protect Aerodactyl (at 45% HP with Sash popped) from single-target attacks like Weather Ball or Bullet Punch.
decisions.notebook: Opponent brought Rain (Politoed + Archaludon). Archaludon eliminated. Remaining possible back Pokémon: Grimmsnarl, Scizor, Staraptor, Noivern. Tailwind active on our side.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Gengar to maximize Shadow Tag removal. If Gengar Shadow Balls Archaludon (likely — guaranteed KO at 32% since +2 Def doesn't help vs special), WB alone has ~55% to KO Gengar at 40%. If Gengar Protects or targets Politoed, combined WB+ES guarantees the KO. Removing Shadow Tag unlocks Noivern/Scizor cleanup; splitting to Aero leaves us trapped and losing.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball vs Archaludon: 44.3-83.2% — guaranteed KO at 32% HP because +2 Def boost is irrelevant (Shadow Ball is special, targets SpD 85). WB(rain) vs Gengar: 38.3-73.3%. ES vs Gengar: 38.9-72.6%. Combined: 77-146% guaranteed KO. Ice Beam vs Aero: 32.6-60.6% (not guaranteed KO at 45%). Archaludon Protect success rate reduced after T1 use. After Gengar falls, Shadow Tag lifts — pivot to Noivern (192 Spe, Timid, Wise Glasses, Infiltrator) or Scizor (Scizorite, Technician, Adamant) for cleanup. Clefable has FollowMe — expect redirection after Gengar falls. Krookodile Choice Scarf Intimidate is a speed tier threat (112-144 raw, likely ~200+ with scarf).

decisions.rationale: Noivern is the safe switch: special attacker (immune to both opp Intimidate users), immune to Krookodile's High Horsepower, resists Arcanine's Flare Blitz (0.5x), and 192 Spe outspeeds everything once opp Tailwind expires in 2 turns. Scizor is 4x weak to Fire (Arcanine Flare Blitz OHKOs) and gets crippled by Intimidate. Noivern can also set Tailwind or fire off rain-accurate Hurricane next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opp team: Gengar-Mega (fainted G1), Aerodactyl (FocusSash, Unnerve, Jolly, TW+RockSlide+WideGuard+Taunt), Clefable (SitrusBerry, Unaware, Bold, FollowMe+Moonblast+HH+Protect), Krookodile (ChoiceScarf, Intimidate, Adamant, HHP+KnockOff+CC+RockSlide), Arcanine (Leftovers, Intimidate, Careful, FlareBlitz+WoW+Snarl+ExtremeSpeed), Empoleon (LifeOrb, Competitive, Modest, FlashCannon+Surf+IceBeam+Protect). Two Intimidate users cripple physical attackers. Clefable FollowMe for redirection. Scizor is 4x weak to Arcanine Flare Blitz — avoid bringing Scizor into Arcanine. Noivern immune to Ground, resists Fire — best switch-in vs Krookodile/Arcanine. Politoed Weather Ball (Water in rain) is SE vs Krookodile and Arcanine. Rain has 3 turns left (Drizzle). Opp Tailwind is the main speed threat; stall it out or match with Noivern Tailwind. For endgame cleanup, Scizor Bullet Punch priority + Close Combat (2x vs Krookodile/Empoleon) is valuable once Intimidate users are removed.

decisions.rationale: Clefable's Follow Me (+2 priority) redirects all incoming attacks away from 45% Aerodactyl into full-HP Clefable, completely nullifying any Draco Meteor from Noivern due to Fairy immunity and taking minimal damage from Politoed. Aerodactyl moves first out of all active Pokémon (400 Speed under Tailwind) to spread heavy Rock Slide damage onto Noivern and Politoed with flinch chances.

Weather Ball (73% min > 45% HP) guarantees KO on Aerodactyl if not redirected. Tailwind gives me 3 turns of speed control after opp Tailwind expires this turn. Most likely opp line is FollowMe+RockSlide (protecting Aero), which still gets Tailwind up. If they double into Noivern instead, I KO Aero and possibly get Tailwind before Noivern falls. Upside of KO+Aero+Tailwind is too high to play passive.
decisions.notebook: Opp team: Gengar-Mega (fainted G1), Aerodactyl (FocusSash consumed, 45% G1, Unnerve, Jolly, TW+RockSlide+WideGuard+Taunt), Clefable (SitrusBerry, Unaware, Bold, FollowMe+Moonblast+HH+Protect, speed 80-112 base so under TW can outspeed or underspeed Noivern 192), Krookodile (ChoiceScarf, Intimidate, Adamant, HHP+KnockOff+CC+RockSlide), Arcanine (Leftovers, Intimidate, Careful, FlareBlitz+WoW+Snarl+ExtremeSpeed), Empoleon (LifeOrb, Competitive, Modest, FlashCannon+Surf+IceBeam+Protect). Two Intimidate users cripple physical attackers — Scizor especially. Clefable FollowMe is primary redirection tool. Noivern has NO Protect — vulnerable to double targets. Scizor 4x weak to Arcanine Flare Blitz, avoid bringing into Arcanine. Politoed Weather Ball is Water in rain (100BP STAB), SE vs Aerodactyl/Krookodile/Arcanine. Rain from Drizzle lasts limited turns — use Weather Ball while rain active. Scizor-Mega raw Speed 95-127 (Adamant), outsped by Aerodactyl 165-200 without Tailwind. Scizor Bullet Punch priority is key endgame tool but 0.5x vs Aerodactyl. Close Combat neutral vs Aero, 2x vs Krookodile/Empoleon. Endgame plan: stall out opp Tailwind, set own Tailwind, clean up with priority + rain-boosted Weather Ball. Save Scizor for late once Intimidate users are removed or weakened.

decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl (200 Speed) outspeeds Noivern (max 192) and guarantees a KO with spread Rock Slide (min 40.1% damage vs 35% HP Noivern) before Noivern can act. Follow Me redirects any potential attack from Politoed away from Aerodactyl, guaranteeing Aerodactyl stays alive to sweep alongside Scarf Krookodile in the endgame once Rain ends next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Politoed, Archaludon (fainted), Noivern, Grimmsnarl/Scizor/Staraptor. Aerodactyl at 200 speed cleanly outspeeds Noivern.

decisions.rationale: Politoed at 34% dies to Rock Slide (76%+ min) — Protect is mandatory. Noivern at 192 may outspeed Aero (165-200); if so, Tailwind goes up before Rock Slide KOs it, letting Scizor enter at 100% with Tailwind next turn. If Noivern loses speed, Scizor still enters clean. Switching Politoed to Scizor is worse since Scizor takes Rock Slide chip on entry. Last rain turn wasted but survival + speed control is the line.

Close Combat neutral vs Aero, 2x vs Krookodile/Empoleon. Endgame: set Tailwind, clean up with priority + Politoed Ice Beam (SE vs Aero). Save Scizor for when Intimidate users are weakened. decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Follow Me (+2 priority) redirects Scizor's Bullet Punch (+1 priority) away from Aerodactyl onto Clefable. Aerodactyl (200 Speed) naturally outspeeds both Politoed (90-122) and Mega Scizor (95-127), as does Choice Scarf Krookodile (216 Speed) in the back, making Tailwind redundant. Aerodactyl uses Rock Slide to pressure Politoed's remaining 34% HP and chip Scizor while Clefable redirects all incoming attacks.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Politoed, Archaludon (fainted), Noivern (fainted), Grimmsnarl/Scizor/Staraptor. Scizor has Scizorite, Bullet Punch, Dual Wingbeat, Close Combat, Protect.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Helping Hand (+5 pri) guarantees boost before anything moves; Mega Bullet Punch (+1 pri) hits Aero before Rock Slide. HH-boosted Mega BP does 58-155% of Aero max HP — minimum exceeds 45%, so ALWAYS KOs if not redirected. If Clefable Follow Mes, redirected BP does 56-129% to Clefable (possible KO thru Sitrus). If Clefable Protects, BP hits Aero for guaranteed KO. Politoed survives if Aero dies before Rock Slide. Best KO guarantee + protects Politoed.

Scizor 4x weak to Arcanine Flare Blitz. Close Combat neutral vs Aero, 2x vs Krookodile/Empoleon. Scizor-Mega revealed G1: Adamant, Atk 222, Def 160, Spe 95. Rain expired turn 5 G1 — Weather Ball now 50BP Normal, Ice Beam is Politoed's best damage. Endgame plan: KO Aero with priority HH+BP, then clean up with Scizor-Mega + Politoed Ice Beam support. Watch for double Intimidate from back Pokémon (Krook/Arcanine) — consider keeping Politoed for special damage when physical Atk drops.

decisions.rationale: Krookodile (216 Speed) outspeeds Politoed (max 122) and OHKOs its remaining 14% HP with High Horsepower before it can land Ice Beam. Aerodactyl outspeeds Scizor's non-priority moves and offers chip plus flinch chance with Rock Slide. Even at -1 Attack, Scizor cannot OHKO full HP Krookodile with Close Combat. Locking into High Horsepower secures the 2v1 endgame against Scizor.

HH (+5 pri) boosts Scizor before BP (+1 pri) hits Aero at 45%. At -1 Atk + HH, BP does 43-102% of Aero max HP — ~97% KO chance. Scizor BP outspeeds both foes via priority. Krook CC can't KO Scizor (22-38%). After Aero faints,2v1 vs locked Scarf Krook is winnable with Ice Beam + CC next turn.

decisions.rationale: Scarf Krookodile outspeeds both foes. Politoed is at 39% HP, well within KO range of High Horsepower (36.5-69.1%). Eliminating Politoed prevents a double-target KO from Ice Beam + Close Combat. At -1 Atk, Scizor's Close Combat deals at most 96.1% to Krookodile, allowing Krookodile to survive and hit Scizor next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Politoed (Drizzle), Archaludon (fainted), Noivern (fainted), Scizor (Scizorite, BP, DW, CC, Protect). Unbrought: Grimmsnarl, Staraptor.

decisions.rationale: Krookodile is the last foe; both Ice Beam (30.7-58.8%) and Close Combat (75.7-140%) are SE 2x. Combined = guaranteed KO if both land. If Krook targets Politoed and KOs it, Close Combat alone still has strong OHKO odds; if not, Scizor Bullet Punch cleans up next turn. If Krook targets Scizor, both survive and KO is guaranteed. Maximize KO chance this turn.
decisions.notebook: Krookodile Choice Scarf locked into HHP (95% acc) — missed Politoed turn 7. HHP does 35-51% to Politoed, possible KO at 39%. Close Combat at -1 Atk does 75.7-140% to Krookodile (possible OHKO). Ice Beam does 30.7-58.8%. Combined guaranteed KO. Scizor at 81% survives any single HHP. If game goes to next turn, Scizor Bullet Punch (priority +1) can finish weakened Krookodile. Opponent brought Gengar-Mega/Aero/Clefable/Krookodile G1; Arcanine and Empoleon not brought. For G2/G3: expect similar Krookodile + Intimidate core; Arcanine threatens Scizor 4x with Flare Blitz. Consider leading Archaludon vs Empoleon (Flash Cannon NVE, Surf weak to Archaludon's Water resist). Noivern has no Protect — avoid bringing into Rock Slide + Follow Me pressure.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Gengar and frail physical attackers into Politoed rain and Mega Scizor left the team without reliable answers to Bullet Punch once Clefable fainted, especially after failing to set Tailwind with Aerodactyl.
reflections.adjustment: Ensure Mega Gengar gets on field early to burn Mega Scizor with Will-O-Wisp, and prioritize setting Tailwind with Aerodactyl to keep offense ahead of rain attackers.
reflections.notebook: Opponent team details revealed: Politoed (Drizzle, Sitrus Berry, Ice Beam, Weather Ball, Helping Hand, Protect), Archaludon (Life Orb, Stamina, Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Protect), Scizor-Mega (Adamant, Bullet Punch, Dual Wingbeat, Close Combat, Protect), Noivern (Wise Glasses, Infiltrator, Hurricane, Draco Meteor, Super Fang, Tailwind). Unbrought: Grimmsnarl, Staraptor. Strategy notes: Opponent relies on Politoed Helping Hand to empower Mega Scizor's Bullet Punch and Close Combat. Gengar's Will-O-Wisp is essential to neuter Scizor.

reflections.summary: Won because Scizor-Mega's Technician Bullet Punch provided reliable priority cleanup after Politoed's Helping Hand boosted it past Clefable and Aerodactyl. Noivern contributed nothing—flinched turn 4, KO'd turn 5 by Rock Slide under Follow Me redirection. Krookodile's HHP miss on turn 7 was pivotal luck; without it Politoed likely falls and the endgame gets tighter. The rain + Scizor core was the real engine; Noivern was dead weight against this Aero + Clefable redirection structure.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Noivern against Rock Slide + Follow Me cores—it lacks Protect and is too fragile to Aero. Consider Archaludon in that slot for G2: it resists Rock Slide, punishes Aerodactyl with Electro Shot, and isn't flinch-bait. Keep Politoed + Scizor-Mega as the anchor pair. Watch for opponent adjusting to bring Arcanine to wall Scizor with Flare Blitz; if Arcanine appears, lead or preserve Archaludon and avoid over-relying on Bullet Punch.
reflections.notebook: Opponent G1 brought: Gengar-Mega, Aerodactyl (FocusSash, Tailwind+RockSlide+WideGuard+Taunt), Clefable (Sitrus, Follow Me redirection), Krookodile (Choice Scarf, HHP/KnockOff/CC/RockSlide, Intimidate). Not brought: Arcanine (Leftovers, FlareBlitz/Wisp/SnarL/ES, Intimidate), Empoleon (LifeOrb, FlashCannon/Surf/IceBeam/Protect, Competitive). Opponent's pattern: Follow Me + Rock Slide flinch strategy with Aero; Krookodile Scarf cleans late. Krookodile HHP is 95% acc — do not assume it hits. Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch + Helping Hand reliably KOs Clefable and Aero through Intimidate. Noivern is a liability vs Rock Slide redirection — drop it for G2 if Aero/Clefable reappear. Arcanine 4x threatens Scizor; if brought G2, prioritize Archaludon and keep Politoed rain up for Weather Ball chip. Empoleon Competitive can punish Intimidate from Krookodile/Arcanine on opponent's own side but Surf is NVE into Archaludon.
